dedupe_keys.name: high resolution gridded co2 and pollutant emission data from road traffic in indian cities

description: High-resolution gridded CO2 and pollutant emission data from road traffic in Indian cities is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Rohith Teja Mittakola et al. India has set an ambitious target of achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2070. Road transport, contributing to 12% of India’s CO2 emissions, plays a significant role in exacerbating urban air pollution. Given India’s swift urbanization, CO2 emissions from this sector could potentially double by 2050, jeopardizing climate goals. Coverage: national (IN); published in 2025. Formats: NetCDF. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1206096974 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
